title: Fix the Broken Fibonacci
description: The program should compute Fibonacci numbers using recursion. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: fibonacci(6) should print 8, following the sequence 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8.
actualProblem: The recursive call uses fibonacci(n - 1) twice instead of fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2), so it doesn't implement the Fibonacci recurrence at all and produces the wrong values.
explanation: The Fibonacci recurrence defines each term as the sum of the two preceding ones: fib(n-1) + fib(n-2). Calling fibonacci(n - 1) twice ignores the n-2 term entirely and computes a different (incorrect) sequence.
